article.title: MUJI新加坡以成對畫面展示旅行用品的日常用法
article.summary: MUJI新加坡與ANAK合作，為MUJI to GO推出Travel, Every Day，把同件用品放在日常和旅行場景。
highlights: 其中一組創意用掛式收納包示範辦公和旅行用途。
活動安排在新加坡指定戶外版位、門店、社交及電商等渠道推廣。
article.why: 零售創意團隊可用同一商品示範不同使用場合，讓功能差異一眼可見。
article.next_step: 選一款商品，做一組通勤和旅行畫面，在門店與電商頁使用一致產品標示。
article.detail: Campaign Brief Asia報道，新加坡團隊以本地常見場景製作成對畫面，用同件MUJI to GO用品展示日常和旅行用途。創意包括把掛式收納包用於辦公用品或旅行護理品。活動計劃跨戶外、門店、社交及電商推廣，品牌可比較不同場景帶來的具體商品查詢。
article.title_en: MUJI Singapore pairs travel and everyday scenes in product creative
article.summary_en: MUJI Singapore and ANAK introduced Travel, Every Day for MUJI to GO, placing the same product in travel and everyday settings.
highlights_en: One execution shows a hanging case for office essentials and travel toiletries.
The Singapore plan covers selected outdoor sites, stores, social and ecommerce.
article.why_en: Retail teams can demonstrate distinct uses for the same item so its function is clear.
article.next_step_en: Pick one item, create commute and travel scenes and use consistent product labels in store and online.
article.detail_en: Campaign Brief Asia reported that the Singapore team pairs familiar local scenes, showing the same MUJI to GO product in everyday and travel use. One example uses a hanging case for desk essentials or travel toiletries. Plans span outdoor, stores, social and ecommerce. Compare the product questions each scene generates.
